sn32.55:1.1: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenekadā abbhaṃ hotīti || || Santi bhikkhu Abbhavalāhakā nāma devā || || Tesaṃ yadā evaṃ hoti || Yaṃ nuna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti || tesantaṃ cetopaṇidhim anvāya abbhaṃ hotīti || || Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenekadā abbhaṃ hotīti || || Sāvatthi || ||
